title: MRF profit falls on higher material costs

timeline.title: MRF profit falls on higher material costs
timeline.line: Q2 net profit fell about 27% to ₹387 crore even as revenue rose about 17%
more: Margins compressed to around 11%, one report said
Business Standard cites a 22.8% fall to ₹417.19 crore instead
Interim dividend of ₹3 a share declared

dossier.headline: MRF's profit falls as material costs squeeze margins
dossier.summary: MRF reported a sharp drop in September-quarter profit despite solid revenue growth, as higher raw-material costs compressed margins. Revenue rose about 17% to ₹8,660 crore; profit fell about 27% to ₹387 crore by one count.
why_it_matters: Shows how input costs are hurting tyre makers even as demand holds up
Cheaper crude could ease rubber and synthetic input costs ahead
watch: The stock's reaction at the open
questions: Will lower oil prices relieve margins next quarter?
conflicts: Business Upturn: profit down 26.6% to ₹386.99 crore; Business Standard: down 22.8% to ₹417.19 crore
